chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Eppie the jazz tuba player
summary: Mosley does not remember where Eppie came from; he was the first jazz tuba player he heard.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Okay, so we still didn't find out where you found Eppie; I know you had to have a bass player because some of the guys in the band couldn't get along with Sparks that well, so where did you find him? Do you remember where you found him?
I don't remember where we got him. So of the guys, including myself, liked Brent. I got along with everybody, but I liked him--
You're not an argumentative kind of guy.
No; but I suggested that we make him the road manager and go in front of us.
Eppie was the better tuba player, wasn't he?
tuba player I ever heard in my life. He could take a tuba and play just as fast as a trumpet player.
That's incredible. Was he featured in the band? Did you give him solos?
Eppie was just a little bit older than I. I would say a couple of years older.
Whatever happend to him, did you ever hear?
I haven't heard a thing about Eppie at all.
